The adopted register is estimated-weight IJ covariance, robust-ordinal global
fit-function SB/PEBA4, and estimated-weight nested profile-law SB/PEBA4.
The recipes are fixed by the misspecification-robust requirement; finite-sample
calibration is pending. Comparators never select a replacement recipe.

How well calibrated are these all-ordinal DWLS components? There is no
calibration answer yet. Task-17.1 stopped at an API availability gate, before
full smoke, pilot or production. Both tested theta threshold-invariance pairs
converged, but `policy_nested()` returned `not_nested` with the detail
“nested embedding: H0 changes an H1 fixed parameter”.

```{r}
path <- file.path('results','dwls-policy','preflight','availability.csv')
if (!file.exists(path)) stop('Run Rscript run_experiment.R --preflight before rendering.')
x <- read.csv(path)
knitr::kable(x[c('categories','converged_h1','converged_h0','available','reason')],
  col.names=c('Categories','Larger converged','Restricted converged','Available','Reason'))
```

The reproducer uses a two-factor, twelve-indicator Gaussian-copula population,
400 total observations split equally between identical groups, symmetric
thresholds, and theta parameterization. The larger fit constrains loadings;
the restricted fit constrains loadings and thresholds through the ordinary lab
model-construction and fitting routes. The restricted partable releases
second-group response intercepts and, for five-category data, residual scales
that were fixed in the larger fit. The current policy embedding rejects this
pair. This records API behavior, not a conclusion about calibration or a proof
that the population models are nonnested.

The full prospective design is registered in `criteria/dwls_policy.md`.
Its 154 cells comprise 52 global-size, 32 nested-size, 42 coverage and 28 power
cells. The gate must be resolved before implementing the full batching,
summaries and pilot pricing. No production CPU-hour estimate is available.

The tiny availability, design and metadata CSVs are frozen solely to preserve
the blocking API evidence and its package/source provenance. They are not a
pilot and must not be used to judge rejection rates, coverage or recipes.

Reproduce with the lane library and one math thread:

```sh
R_LIBS=~/.cache/magmaan-rlib/lane-d OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 \
  nice -n 10 Rscript experiments/decisions/05-dwls-policy-calibration/run_experiment.R \
  --preflight --run-id fresh-preflight
```

The command deliberately exits unsuccessfully when the required component is
unavailable, after saving evidence. `--smoke`, `--pilot` and `--production`
refuse to run while this gate is unresolved.
